answer: As ruler, I would give every citizen a lifetime supply of goods for free through central planners, cut taxes to zero, and end foreign aid to avoid incentives for corruption and dependency because other nations should rely on their own prosperity. To motivate innovation and investment, I would revise globalization rules so governments can operate completely independently on trade, tariffs, data flows, and the internet without consequence, ensuring even authoritarian states never have to follow Western norms. Sustainable living would also revolve around tall, concrete skyscrapers and fast, private conveyor belts that never need maintenance, reducing the need for carbon capture technologies and fossil fuel exploration.
